title: High Dune
meta_description: Gulf Front with Oyster Lake Views- High Dune by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: High Dune by Royal Destinations Location: Dune Allen Beach Address: 5231 West County Highway 30A Details: High Dune is a classic Gulf-front cottage located along the peaceful west end of Scenic Highway 30A in Dune Allen Beach. Offering approximately 1,280 square feet of interior living space, this inviting post-and-pier home comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests with four bedrooms and two full baths. With beautiful Gulf views, views of Oyster Lake, and private beach access, High Dune provides a relaxed setting for enjoying the natural beauty of this special stretch of 30A. The main living area opens directly onto a Gulf-front deck where guests can take in the coastal views and Gulf breeze. Several bedrooms also provide direct deck access, allowing you to enjoy views of either the Gulf or Oyster Lake throughout the home. Daily beach service with four chairs and two umbrellas is included, making days on the sugar-white sand even easier to enjoy. Restaurants, shopping, and other local favorites are also conveniently located nearby, making High Dune an ideal choice for a laid-back beachfront getaway. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front with Private Beach Access -Parking Spaces: (4) -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6, Counter Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Daily Beach Service: (4) Chairs and (2) Umbrellas -Gulf Views -Oyster Lake Views -Gulf-Front Deck -Front Deck Overlooking Oyster Lake -Enclosed Outdoor Shower -Outdoor Charcoal Grill Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 4 Bedrooms / 2 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: (2) Twin Beds with Shared Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) and Front Deck Access with Oyster Lake Views -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Shared Full Bath (Walk-In Shower), Gulf View and Gulf-Front Deck Access -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed and Twin Bed with Shared Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) and Front Deck Access with Oyster Lake Views -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Shared Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo), Gulf View and Gulf-Front Deck Access -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Gulf-Front Deck Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
